text:
eva: quick idea — adding a ‘simulate & export’ button to the autofallback policy editor so SREs can replay decisions against historical telemetry before rolling out. saves us from surprises in prod.

joel: interesting. we already have playback for rollouts but it's sandboxed per-policy. you mean run it against real archived traces (anonymized) and produce a timeline + CSV? :thinking_face:

eva: yeah — select window (eg last 72h), run sim, get a playback with timestamps, chosen fallback steps, and reason codes. also an exportable CSV for audits and biz teams.

anya: +1. important we surface which trigger fired (latency, qps, error-rate) and the evaluation order. otherwise people will blame the UI when it was really a routing mis-match.

sam: ops ask: retention for those archived traces? we can't keep raw request payloads forever. need clear retention + redaction rules in the feature.

maria-pm: product question — who owns the exported artifact? customer? internal? both. we should let orgs opt-in to allow export of PII-stripped traces for enterprise tenants.

eva: prototype policy snippet I mocked (for the editor) — shows evaluation order and actions:

```
{
  "policy_name": "rollback_safe_autofallback",
  "evaluate_order": ["latency_spike","error_ratio","quota_exhausted"],
  "actions": [
    {"type":"fallback_model","variant":"cheap-v2","reason_code":"latency_spike"},
    {"type":"serve_from_cache","ttl_s":30,"reason_code":"quota_exhausted"},
    {"type":"reject","status":503,"reason_code":"hard_failure"}
  ],
  "audit": {"retain_days":30,"exportable":true}
}
```

joel: couple things:
- the simulate UI must replay exact routing decisions including which region/pool was chosen.
- we need trace ids attached to each simulated decision so customers can cross-ref logs.
- the CSV should include columns: timestamp, trigger, chosen_action, trace_id, model_version, latency_ms, upstream_code

ops-qa: threshold question — when simulating across 72h with bursts, do we apply the policy as currently configured (static) or let it evolve with autoscaling configs? i.e., simulation should be configurable: snapshot infra state vs live autoscaling.

eva: good point. propose two modes: "snapshot" (policy + infra config at time X) and "replay-with-autoscale" (simulate autoscaler responses using the recorded metrics). make that explicit in UI.

anya: also surface confidence/ambiguity where two triggers overlap (eg latency spike + error ratio) — show which rule won and why (tie-breaker order). tiny UI affordance: click a decision to open a mini-diff of rule evaluation.

sam: security: exports must be scoped to RBAC. don't let engineers export org-level artifacts unless they have compliance_export role. log every export as an auditable event.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary build 0.1.32 deployed to staging at 3654321200 — run simulated playback for policy rollback_safe_autofallback? :rocket:

eva: haha yes — can we add a quick runner to staging that takes a single click to replay the last 24h traces into staging with redaction? good for QA.

maria-pm: add a checkbox: "include human readable decision reasons" vs "compact machine CSV" — both are useful for different audits. PM + legal like readable reasons.

joel: telemetry correlation: include a column for sampling_rate_at_time — if traces were sampled at 10% during the event, callers should know simulation is approximate.

ops-qa: also we should surface a simulated SLA impact score: e.g., expected p95 latency delta, cost delta (token cost), and failure-rate delta when enabling policy. simple estimates.

eva: agreed. keep estimates conservative and flag uncertainty.

anya: UX nit — in the policy editor show a small history badge: "last simulated Xh ago" and quick link to most recent export.

sam: implementation note: backend will need to support replay pipeline + redaction + RBAC + export. suggests adding a replay-service micro to eng-platform.

joel: dev API debate: should simulate be a synchronous endpoint (blocks until finished) or async job with webhook? async feels safer for long windows.

eva: async + streaming logs to the UI. provide a job id so users can re-run, share, or schedule nightly regressions.

maria-pm: for audits, we should persist simulation artifacts for configurable retention per-org (default 30d). legal needs the ability to request exports historically.

ops-qa: edge case: if a policy references a model that no longer exists, simulation should annotate with "model_missing" and offer to map to compatible alternatives.

eva: OK next steps proposal:
- design: mockups for simulate modal, modes (snapshot/replay), export options, RBAC controls (maria)
- infra: design replay-service + storage + redaction plan (joel, sam)
- api: async job API + job schema + webhook (anya)
- telemetry: list of required columns for CSV + uncertainty fields (ops-qa)

anya: I'll take the API bits + decision diffs.
joel: I'll write infra doc and sketch retention/keys.
sam: will scope RBAC & redaction work.
maria-pm: I'll align with legal and get acceptance criteria for exportable artifacts.

eva: thanks all. tagging @maria-pm @joel @anya for prioritization. pushing a prototype on figma next week.

maria-pm: :thumbsup: good convo. booking sync with legal and compliance for Fri 10am.

joel: noted — I'll post a short RFC once infra sketch is ready.

ops-qa: leaving a checklist comment here: ensure sampling_rate, trace_id, model_version columns are present. also add a check for missing model mapping.

eva: thanks — logging follow-up tasks to the rollout project board. :white_check_mark:
